# Super Ideal Sweets & Bakers

> More than sweets, it's a feeling. Mithai, biscuits, bakery, cakes, pizzas, and gift boxes from Super Ideal in Faisalabad.

Super Ideal Sweets & Bakers has prepared sweets and bakery in Faisalabad since 1969. Orders are placed online. Prices are in Pakistani rupees.
